import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile

path = Path('tests/test_inventory_and_profiles.py')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('review_b_inventory_tests', path)
assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
generator = module._load_generator()
filesystem = generator.secure_filesystem
raw_create, _, _, raw_close = filesystem._windows_directory_api()
invalid = filesystem.ctypes.c_void_p(-1).value
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='pontius-review-b-probe-') as temporary:
    root = Path(temporary)
    missing = root / 'absent'
    arguments = (
        str(missing), 0x00000020 | 0x00000080 | 0x00100000,
        0x00000001 | 0x00000002 | 0x00000004, None, 3,
        0x02000000 | 0x00200000, None,
    )
    raw_result = raw_create(*arguments)
    raw_error = filesystem.ctypes.get_last_error()
    assert int(raw_result) == invalid and raw_error != 0
    with module._ControlledWindowsHandles(filesystem) as routing:
        routed_create = filesystem._windows_directory_api()[0]
        routed_result = routed_create(*arguments)
        routed_error = filesystem.ctypes.get_last_error()
        assert int(routed_result) == invalid
        assert routed_error == raw_error, (routed_error, raw_error)
        token = generator._windows_open_governance_directory(root)[0]
        native = routing.live[token]
        routed_close = filesystem._windows_directory_api()[3]
        assert routed_close(filesystem.wintypes.HANDLE(token))
        assert token not in routing.live
        assert not routing.native_is_open(native)
        assert not routed_close(filesystem.wintypes.HANDLE(token))
        assert filesystem.ctypes.get_last_error() == 6
        filesystem.ctypes.set_last_error(1234)
        try:
            generator._windows_governance_handle_is_open(routing.TOKEN_START + 999)
        except AssertionError as error:
            assert 'unknown synthetic handle' in str(error)
        else:
            raise AssertionError('unknown token reached Windows')
        assert filesystem.ctypes.get_last_error() == 1234
    routing = module._ControlledWindowsHandles(filesystem)
    original_raw_close = routing.raw_close
    token = None
    native = None
    try:
        with routing:
            token = generator._windows_open_governance_directory(root)[0]
            native = routing.live[token]
            routing.raw_close = lambda _handle: 0
            raise ValueError('review-b-primary')
    except AssertionError as error:
        assert isinstance(error.__cause__, ValueError)
        assert 'close failures' in str(error)
        assert token in routing.live and routing.live[token] == native
        assert filesystem.ctypes is routing.ctypes
    else:
        raise AssertionError('failed fallback close did not fail teardown')
    finally:
        assert native is not None
        assert original_raw_close(filesystem.wintypes.HANDLE(native))
        routing.live.clear()
print('review-b adversarial API/error/refusal/teardown probes passed')
